name: Potential Tampering With Security Products Via WMIC
description: Detects uninstallation or termination of security products using the WMIC utility
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.command_line:*wmic* AND process.command_line:*product\ where\ * AND process.command_line:*call* AND process.command_line:*uninstall* AND process.command_line:*\/nointeractive*) OR ((process.command_line:*wmic* AND process.command_line:*caption\ like\ *) AND (process.command_line:(*call\ delete* OR *call\ terminate*))) OR (process.command_line:*process\ * AND process.command_line:*where\ * AND process.command_line:*delete*)) AND (process.command_line:(*%carbon%* OR *%cylance%* OR *%endpoint%* OR *%eset%* OR *%malware%* OR *%Sophos%* OR *%symantec%* OR *Antivirus* OR *AVG\ * OR *Carbon\ Black* OR *CarbonBlack* OR *Cb\ Defense\ Sensor\ 64\-bit* OR *Crowdstrike\ Sensor* OR *Cylance\ * OR *Dell\ Threat\ Defense* OR *DLP\ Endpoint* OR *Endpoint\ Detection* OR *Endpoint\ Protection* OR *Endpoint\ Security* OR *Endpoint\ Sensor* OR *ESET\ File\ Security* OR *LogRhythm\ System\ Monitor\ Service* OR *Malwarebytes* OR *McAfee\ Agent* OR *Microsoft\ Security\ Client* OR *Sophos\ Anti\-Virus* OR *Sophos\ AutoUpdate* OR *Sophos\ Credential\ Store* OR *Sophos\ Management\ Console* OR *Sophos\ Management\ Database* OR *Sophos\ Management\ Server* OR *Sophos\ Remote\ Management\ System* OR *Sophos\ Update\ Manager* OR *Threat\ Protection* OR *VirusScan* OR *Webroot\ SecureAnywhere* OR *Windows\ Defender*))
